## CachedRelayRegistry Class

Adds optional in\-memory, demand\-triggered caching to a relay registry\.

```csharp
public sealed class CachedRelayRegistry : Meshline.Interactions.IRelayRegistry, System.IAsyncDisposable
```

Inheritance [System\.Object](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.object 'System\.Object') → CachedRelayRegistry

Implements [IRelayRegistry](Meshline.Interactions.IRelayRegistry.md 'Meshline\.Interactions\.IRelayRegistry'), [System\.IAsyncDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.iasyncdisposable 'System\.IAsyncDisposable')

### Remarks
Reads return cached entries immediately while a due refresh runs in the background\. Successful refreshes<br>
defer the next refresh for one hour; failures and missing entries defer retries for one minute\.<br>
No timer runs without read demand\. These intervals do not define registration validity\.<br>
Each instance is isolated to its source registry and network, and may be shared by multiple pools\.<br>
Dispose the wrapper after its consumers; the source remains owned by the caller\.
